title: A connector a mixed composed input declares only at its top level beside package bodies is invisible to the lender at boot, yet the composed check accepts a borrow of it
body:
epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Filing gate: ③ escalation in the contract review of PR #28026 (record 6519281283 ③ item 3, VERDICT PASS), confirming the dev's out-of-scope note in os-dev-report 6518764127. It is outside that PR's surface, and that card forbids it to change an accept set.
Ruling-ref: D7 ruling 6486136301 (connector-credential borrowing)
Dedupe (open AND closed): "registerUnclaimedTopLevel connector lender readDeclaredConnectorItems residual" → none this work.
Reader: the epic PM (#27261) dispatches it in the epic subtree.
type: Bug

## 维护者速读

- **问题：** 合成栈（`composeStacks`）里，如果某个输入既带 `packages[]` 包体，又只在顶层声明了一个连接器实例（没有包体声明同名），那么开机时这个实例只注册进元数据服务，而凭据出借方读的是 ObjectQL 注册表，看不到它。结果数据源 `external.connector` 借用它时，开机借不到凭据；要等一次开发态重载后才能借到。但构建期的合成检查认为它可借、放行了，构建和运行结论不一致。
- **影响：** 只有手工构造的嵌套或混合输入（多包项目的 `preserve` 合成）会遇到，常规单栈和 `last` 扁平合成不受影响。属于边缘形状，p3。
- **需要您做的：** 无。修法有两个方向（运行时把残留顶层连接器注册进出借方能看到的地方，或者合成检查拒收这种借用），先实测再定；会改变作者能写什么的，回报 epic PM 再定。

## Measured by reading (record 6519281283 ③ item 3, at `origin/main` 3f02da10f8)

- `MetadataPlugin.registerUnclaimedTopLevel` (metadata/plugin.ts :1475-1497) registers a residual top-level item through the door's sink. On the artifact door that is `memLoader.save` + `this.manager.register` (:1385-1391). On the config door it is `metadata.registerInMemory` (runtime/app-plugin.ts :1127-1148). Both go into the metadata service's registry.
- The ObjectQL `manifest` service registers the bodies via `ql.registerApp`, and of the residual it registers OBJECTS only (`unclaimedTopLevelObjects`, objectql/plugin.ts :143-153, :773-848).
- The lender reads `readDeclaredConnectorItems` (service-automation/plugin.ts :1104-1109, :1938-1972), that is `protocol.getMetaItemsForExecution({ type: 'connector' })`, which is `engine.registry.listItems` plus the `sys_metadata` overlay (metadata-protocol/protocol.ts :9469-9500). It never reads the metadata service's list.
- A dev reload makes the entry visible (`captureReloadedConnectors` :1890-1905).
- Accepted at build today: `composeStacks([mixed(instance), looseBorrower], { manifest: 'preserve' })`. The only declaration is the mixed input's top-level instance, in slot `package:<mixed id>`, so it is kept, can lend, and is accepted.

## Task

- [ ] Measure first. Boot an artifact of the accepted shape above, then borrow through the datasource. Confirm it refuses at boot and lends after a reload. If it lends at boot, close this card with the measurement.
- [ ] If it reproduces, choose the fix from the measurement and say why in the PR. Option (a): the residual top-level connector (unclaimed by any body) registers where the lender reads, for example the ObjectQL registry under the composed `manifest.id`, the way residual objects already do. Option (b): the composed check refuses a borrow whose only lending declaration is a top-level entry beside package bodies. (b) narrows what an author can declare. Stop and report to the epic PM before taking it.
- [ ] A test pins the boot-time borrow on that shape, both directions.

`Clause-②:` decided from the diff · `Metadata-protocol: none`. A spec edit (option b) owes a contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
